data.body: Reconciliation path (debug-everything 2026-05-11): To fix the 69 type + 76 priority mismatches, a one-shot script would: (1) scan .tickets-tracker/ for tickets with *-SYNC.json files to find Jira-synced tickets, (2) for each, read the local ticket_type and priority, (3) write a fresh EDIT event to the ticket directory (same format as an EDIT event emitter). On the next outbound bridge run, _outbound_handlers handle_edit_event will push the corrected type/priority to Jira. This is data remediation, not a behavior fix. No new bridge bugs will produce these mismatches — the translation code is correct since 2026-03-24. Deferring reconciliation script to a follow-up sprint.
